about: Own-words reads from the daily research task (ADMIS, Rabobank, Czapp and the news feed). fund_score: -1 bearish to +1 bullish, a judgement on the fundamental news only.

cotton.fundamental: Mar rallied into the close to ~82.9, clearing Tuesday's highs and the 82.7 resistance as a weaker dollar and firmer crude helped outside money back in. No new supply or demand data; old-crop Mar/May keeps leaning on Texas Plains losses, but high-grade certs stay a two-sided risk for longs.
events: Dollar index slips, firmer crude (WSJ, Pro Farmer)

sugar.fundamental: ICE US is shut for Thanksgiving, but the real jumped about 2% to ~5.77 per dollar overnight, which makes forward selling less attractive for centre-south mills and should underpin Mar when trade resumes Friday. The new US tariff proposal on Brazil matters for the protected US domestic market rather than for world #11 flows; still no fresh Brazil crush or mix data.
events: Real strengthens ~2% vs the dollar (Yahoo Finance)
New US tariffs would likely lift US sugar prices (Reuters)
ICE US closed for Thanksgiving; Mar last ~18.4 (ICE)

coffee.fundamental: No ICE US trade today; the sharp overnight rise in the real helps Mar (~268.6) by slowing Brazilian farmer selling. Whether coffee is caught by the new US tariff proposal is not yet clear (it was exempted in the July round), and that only matters for US-delivered flows; deliverability and the rebuild of ICE certified stocks remain the bearish anchor.
events: Real up ~2% vs the dollar overnight (Yahoo Finance)
US proposes new tariffs on Brazilian imports, coverage still unclear (Reuters)
Brazilian arabica still heading to ICE warehouses (Finimize, CNN Brasil)

cocoa.fundamental: New York is closed for Thanksgiving; London trades thinly. No new Ivory Coast arrivals figure or Ghana COCOBOD news since Wednesday, and no November ICCO quarterly bulletin yet, so the slow-arrivals story and rising ICE certified stocks keep pulling in opposite directions.
events: Ivorian port arrivals still running slow (Maritime Professional, Barchart)
ICE US closed for Thanksgiving; Mar last ~5,420 (ICE)
No new ICCO quarterly bulletin found yet (ICCO)
